component.name: NotTeams
component.summary: Unofficial native client for Microsoft Teams chats and calls

description.p: NotTeams is a small native desktop client for Microsoft Teams. It talks to the same Microsoft services as the Teams web app, so your chats, channels and meetings are the ones you see there. Where the desktop shows tray icons, it keeps running in the tray, so messages and calls reach you with the window closed.
NotTeams is not made, endorsed or supported by Microsoft. Microsoft Teams is a trademark of Microsoft Corporation.

ul.li: Chats and channels with pictures, files, reactions, replies, edits and message search
One-to-one audio and video calls, and Teams meetings with a pre-join screen, screen sharing and background blur
Presence and status messages, and you show as Away after 5 minutes without input
A calendar of your meetings: accept, decline and join them
Desktop notifications, an alert when a meeting starts, and a choice of sounds
Video uses Cisco's OpenH264 codec, downloaded from Cisco on first start

screenshot.caption: Chats with reactions, presence and unread messages

ul.li: The app's listing in GNOME Software now has screenshots of the chat and calendar views and a longer description of what NotTeams does.
Sign in with your Microsoft account by entering a short code on Microsoft's sign-in page. NotTeams keeps you signed in until you sign out.
Chats and channels, kept up to date, with a setting for which teams and channels the list shows
Read, send, edit and delete messages, and reply to channel posts. Quoted replies are shown apart from the message text.
Pictures and files are shown in chats and can be opened with your own apps or saved to Downloads. Send them with the paperclip or by dropping them onto the window.
Reactions on messages
Start a one-to-one chat by searching for a person's name or email
Search messages across all chats and channels (Ctrl+E or Ctrl+Alt+E)
Activity feed with reactions, replies, mentions and new posts in channels you follow
Presence: photos and status dots for everyone, and you can set your own status and status message. You show as Away after 5 minutes without input, unless "Always available" is on.
Calendar of your meetings: reply Accept, Tentative or Decline, join Teams meetings, and add or delete events
One-to-one audio and video calls from a chat. Incoming calls ring with an Accept/Decline card, also while NotTeams is in the tray.
Teams meetings with a pre-join screen (camera preview, microphone meter, device choice), raised hands, reactions, pinning a participant to the big tile and admitting people from the lobby
Screen sharing, and the other person's shared screen is shown in one-to-one calls
Background blur for your camera
Choose the microphone, speaker and camera in Settings → Calls or during a call. A test call to Teams' Echo service lets you check your microphone and speaker.
An alert with sound when a meeting starts in one of your chats
Sounds for new messages, incoming calls and meeting starts, each chosen in Settings from six built-in sounds
Tray icon with a count of new messages and activity. Closing the window keeps NotTeams running in the tray.
Video in calls uses Cisco's OpenH264 codec, which NotTeams downloads from Cisco on first start. You can turn it off in Settings → Calls, and calls then have no video.
Settings for how long downloaded pictures and files are kept, and for clearing them
Available as a Flatpak from the hwnhub channel, updated through GNOME Software or flatpak update
